question: I would like to know the given names of baseball players who have achieved the highest value of games played, runs, hits, and home runs, with their corresponding score values.
sql:
SET sqlite_all_varchar=true;
SELECT 
  (SELECT name_given FROM batting b JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY g DESC LIMIT 1) as name_given_games,
  (SELECT g FROM batting ORDER BY g DESC LIMIT 1) as games,
  (SELECT name_given FROM batting b JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 1) as name_given_runs,
  (SELECT r FROM batting ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 1) as runs,
  (SELECT name_given FROM batting b JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY h DESC LIMIT 1) as name_given_hits,
  (SELECT h FROM batting ORDER BY h DESC LIMIT 1) as hits,
  (SELECT name_given FROM batting b JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id ORDER BY hr DESC LIMIT 1) as name_given_homeruns,
  (SELECT hr FROM batting ORDER BY hr DESC LIMIT 1) as home_runs

WITH max_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(g) as max_g,
    MAX(r) as max_r,
    MAX(h) as max_h,
    MAX(hr) as max_hr
  FROM batting
),
players_with_max AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    p.name_given,
    b.g as games,
    b.r as runs,
    b.h as hits,
    b.hr as home_runs
  FROM batting b
  JOIN player p ON b.player_id = p.player_id
  JOIN max_stats ms ON 
    b.g = ms.max_g OR b.r = ms.max_r OR b.h = ms.max_h OR b.hr = ms.max_hr
)
SELECT * FROM players_with_max
ORDER BY games DESC, runs DESC, hits DESC, home_runs DESC
